description.value: Fireside Café sits at the main entrance of Menno Hospital on the Menno Place seniors' care campus, one of BC's largest with 700 residents across 11 acres. It offers cozy indoor tables and an outdoor patio, serving hot bento boxes and soft serve ice cream. The café is operated by the Mennonite Benevolent Society and is open to residents, families, and visitors to the campus.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Fireside Café is a small café at the main entrance of Menno Hospital, part of the Menno Place seniors' care campus in Abbotsford, BC. The address on the website (32945 Marshall Road, Abbotsford) differs from the OSM community tag of 'Chilliwack'. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website. The café primarily serves residents, families, and friends of the seniors care facility.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'Chilliwack' but the website address is Abbotsford (32945 Marshall Road, Abbotsford, BC V2S 1K1) — likely an OSM data error.
OSM has a secondary url tag (http://firesidecafe.ca) that was not fetched; it is unclear whether this is a separate business or an alias.
Café is located inside Menno Hospital on a seniors care campus; public access for drop-in cyclists is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is an institutional café embedded within a hospital and seniors care campus, primarily serving residents and their families rather than the general public or passing cyclists. It may be accessible to cyclists but warrants human review to determine whether it meets the spirit of the WWC directory.
